LAYER 3 - ADVANCED Advanced derivation and school divergence Dependent origination is not a search for the universe's first cause.

groups.heading: ADVANCED OBJECTION
items: It diagnoses the structure of conditioned becoming here and now.
This avoids eternalism because no unchanged self grounds the process, and avoids annihilationism because causal continuity remains.
The doctrine supports different ontological conclusions.
Mādhyamika argues that whatever depends on conditions lacks svabhāva and is therefore empty.

groups.heading: COMPARATIVE NUANCE
items: Vaibhāṣika and Sautrāntika instead emphasise that causally functioning conditioned events are real.
Their disagreement concerns ultimate status, not whether dependent arising occurs.
The strongest challenge is regress: if every event is conditioned, what explains the chain as a whole?
The Buddhist reply is therapeutic and structural rather than foundational—the task is to identify and cease the conditions
